title: R18 (Racing ED) Bike
notes: Current exact manufacturer page identifies R18 (Racing ED) as a TWITTER model and publishes WheelTop GEX 1x13, Shimano 105 R7120 2x12 and Shimano 105 Di2 R7170 2x12 configurations. It specifies a T800/T1000 high-modulus carbon frame, T800 fork, T47 bottom bracket, 58 mm carbon wheels and fitted Maxxis Pursuer 700x28C tires; the R7170 build is listed at 7.7 kg. No maximum tire clearance or numeric stiffness test is published.
